data.description: Your hair loses its color and your sleep is interrupted by nightmares that never leave your mind. You take a -%1 penalty on saving throws against fear effects, and you lose any immunities to fear you might otherwise possess. You gain immunity to effects that would remove your fear (such as remove fear).|ShadowboundFrightfulBonus*2
